From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -0000
Subject: Q2 revenue cadence — submission window & top-opportunity signoffs

Team —

Quick reminder: the Q2 forecast submission window opens today at 9:00 PT and closes EOD Friday. I want to make sure we leave the commit call on Friday with two concrete things: (1) all deals we plan to count in Q2 have stage & probability updated in HubSpot, and (2) each top-5 deal has a named next step and a confirmed mutual action plan.

Action items for this week (short):
- Update stage and expected close date for any opportunity changing in the next 60 days.
- Add a short note on gating risks (contract, security, procurement) in the HubSpot notes.
- Attach the latest snapshot to the thread (I pulled a pivot of weighted ARR by rep).

I’ve scheduled a 30-min cadence call for Friday 11:00 PT to review commits and triage any high-risk rows — agenda below. Please update the shared sheet before joining.

Draft agenda for Friday 11:00 PT (30m):
1) Quick roll call + any withdrawn deals (5m)
2) Top 10 at-risk/opportunity signoffs (15m) — one slide per rep
3) Pricing/terms exceptions and Deal Desk flags (5m)
4) Action items and owner assignments (5m)

Attachments: Q2_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx (pivot + notes)

If you need to move the call, ping me today — otherwise assume confirmed.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor Obrien
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Connor —

Thanks for the heads up. I pulled the sheet and started a brief hygiene pass. A couple of things I noticed that we should call out on Friday:
- ACME-348: close date pushed + procurement still needs the SOC2 evidence (I'll loop in Deal Desk).
- ACME-402: pricing variance requested (customer asked for 12-mo vs 24-mo term pricing).

I attached a 1-page "handoff" (weekly-handoff-agenda.pdf) that mirrors the Friday agenda and includes a short checklist for each rep to run through before the call.

I'll lead the pricing/terms exceptions section. For top-10 signoffs, can we keep each rep to a 60s verbal summary and use the sheet for details? Keeps the call on time.

On the attachments: Q2_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx has a 'needs_evidence' flag I added for internal tracking.

Thanks —
Marissa

Adding a quick pipeline hygiene note: please ensure stages are set to one of the canonical values (Discovery, Evaluation, Negotiation, Contracting, Closed-Won, Closed-Lost). I ran a script and found ~32 rows with free-text stage values — those inflate our pipeline and make weighted numbers noisy.

Two practical asks for reps this week:
- Standardize the stage to the nearest canonical stage and add a 1-line reason in the HubSpot note if you adjusted it.
- Mark any deal that needs external approvals (legal, procurement) using the 'needs_evidence' flag in the sheet.

Connor — can we get salesops to run a one-time cleanup task Thursday night to normalize stage values that look like typos? I'll coordinate with Ops.

Karthik
